concept_use.Rotation of axes: The rotation formulas give cos theta = 12/13, sin theta = 5/13 from the point (2,3) -> (3,2), and then transform y = x into 17Y = 7X.

english: The coordinate axes are rotated about the origin through an angle $\theta$, $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, in the anticlockwise sense. The point whose coordinates are $(2,3)$ in the original system has coordinates $(3,2)$ in the new system. Then the equation of the line $y=x$, referred to the new axes $X$ and $Y$, is
hindi: निर्देशांक अक्षों को मूल बिन्दु के परितः वामावर्त दिशा में कोण $\theta$, $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, से घुमाया जाता है। जिस बिन्दु के मूल निकाय में निर्देशांक $(2,3)$ हैं, उसके नए निकाय में निर्देशांक $(3,2)$ हैं। तब नए अक्षों $X$ तथा $Y$ के सापेक्ष रेखा $y=x$ का समीकरण है
solution_full: For an anticlockwise rotation of the axes through $\theta$: $X=x\cos\theta+y\sin\theta$, $Y=-x\sin\theta+y\cos\theta$, and conversely $x=X\cos\theta-Y\sin\theta$, $y=X\sin\theta+Y\cos\theta$.

Multiply the first by $2$ and the second by $3$ and add: $13\cos\theta=12$, so $\cos\theta=\dfrac{12}{13}$; then $3\sin\theta=3-\dfrac{24}{13}=\dfrac{15}{13}$, so $\sin\theta=\dfrac5{13}$. Both are positive, consistent with $0<\theta<\frac{\pi}{2}$.
Check: the line $y=x$ makes $45^\circ$ with the old $x$-axis, so in the new system its slope is $\tan(45^\circ-\theta)=\dfrac{1-\frac5{12}}{1+\frac5{12}}=\dfrac7{17}$.
originality_note: New: the angle of rotation is not given but recovered from one point whose coordinates are interchanged by the rotation, and then a line is transformed (way 3: the transformation is fixed by a condition). Closest known: 'rotate the axes through 45 degrees and find the new equation of a curve'. Different because: theta must first be solved from a linear system in cos and sin.

key_step: Solving the two rotation equations for cos theta and sin theta, then substituting the inverse formulas.
